part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `src/OrderedMap.js:64` — `__iterate` returned the raw internal-list index count, which includes tombstone entries left behind by `.remove()` on non-last elements. `hashCollection` (src/CollectionImpl.js:761) uses that return value as the collection's `size` in the final hash mix, so OrderedSets/OrderedMaps containing the same elements built by different paths got different hashCodes (and correspondingly, `equals` could disagree via `__hash` short-circuiting).

The fix counts only actual (non-deleted) entries visited. Full test suite passes (44 suites, 685 tests) and lint is clean.
